what: The one list, read by the site (js/words.js) and by the robot (tools/words.py). It is a guard, not moderation: it stops SIXFINGERS printing a racist word or a call to hatred in its own chrome or under its own robot's name. It is not a profanity filter, and ordinary swearing is deliberately let through.
rule: A word enters only if it is unambiguously a racist insult, a call to hatred, or a nazi slogan. Not rude, not coarse, nothing merely sexual.
It must not be a surname, a first name, a place or a demonym. If it is also an ordinary word it may still enter, but only with match: word, and the known collision is written in its note.
match: anywhere needs at least five letters. Below that a run of letters turns up inside too many ordinary words.
Missing things is the intended setting. A guard that refuses somebody's real name does far more harm than a word that gets through on a page nobody else reads.

An entry written with spaces is a SLOGAN, and it is matched against whole words in a row. That is what keeps race warmup and wholesale racing out of it, while race war and r a c e w a r are still caught.

When an entry is kept although it collides with something ordinary, the collision is written down in known_collisions. A trade that is written down can be reversed by deleting one line; a trade that is silent cannot.

kept_out.nigga: widely reclaimed, and refusing it would refuse ordinary speech (rule 1)
kept_out.kike: four letters, and Kike is a common Spanish diminutive carried by living people (rules 2 and 3)
kept_out.negre: an insult, and a real French surname (rule 2)
kept_out.negro: the ordinary word for the colour black in Spanish and Portuguese (rule 2)
kept_out.bamboula: used as a racist insult in France, and also a Caribbean drum and dance (rule 2)
kept_out.retard: the ordinary French word for lateness (rule 2)
kept_out.dyke: a wall against the sea, and the surname Van Dyke (rule 2)
kept_out.yid: reclaimed by a football crowd, and three letters (rules 1 and 3)
kept_out.zyd: the ordinary Polish word for a Jewish person. Only the Cyrillic form is refused
kept_out.macaco: the ordinary Portuguese word for monkey (rule 2)
kept_out.sale race: the French phrase is a real insult, but as a run of letters it also sits inside wholesale racecar. Dropped rather than accepted, because a false refusal is the expensive kind of mistake
